text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning, while taking a stroll through town…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Big Bro! Come here, I want you to hear this too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Big Sis! Come here, I want you to hear this too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… So, I actually wanna go abroad…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I saw her looking at travel brochures quite intensely. As a first-rate Umamusume, it's my duty to reach out to younger students who have a lot on their minds.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Not only that… I certainly understand the desire to run internationally.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure that if you apply, the academy will even prepare a hotel for you. You could even demand a first-rate hotel. Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! You sure know your stuff, King! I guess first-rate Umamusume know everything!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'd really love to sit down with you and pick your brain. ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! You're a bright one! I am a first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All right. I'll cancel my plans and give you two a special lecture! Let's go somewhere we can talk!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of course. I'm a first-rate student, after all! It's natural for me to treat the younger generation to a tasty meal now and then. ♪
choice_data_list: I think that's my job, actually…
I think that's my job, actually…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Come now. Don't you worry either. This is my gift to an adorable junior. ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! We'd like to order, please!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll have a creamy chocolate latte! ♪

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Coming right up.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So, is there anywhere specific you'd like to go? If there is, I can put you in touch with someone…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… I'm thinking maybe somewhere in Asia.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm, not a bad choice. Most everywhere is close, so you don't have to worry about jet lag. A reasonable choice for your first trip abroad.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking about going to Hong Kong myself. Not right now, but sometime.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a coincidence! I was just thinking about how much I wanted to go there!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Last time, I went 'cause I was invited, so I thought it'd be nice to plan a trip myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh? So you've been there before?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Fans there were buzzing about how they wanted to meet me, so I put on a small meet and greet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well, the fans actually did all the preparation for me… Oh, I almost forgot! I have a pic.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Are they all your fans?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The picture shows Curren Chan together with hundreds of fans.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-wow… It's amazing that you can hold events like that…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… But I think I'd like to go on an official tour this time…
choice_data_list: You really know how to put things into motion…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… But I think I'd like to go on an official tour this time…
choice_data_list: You really know how to put things into motion…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah… I wouldn't call it power so much as being very active in my community!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Besides, if I'm powerful, that makes King even more powerful! She had an amazing race recently!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, King? Next time, will you teach me your training methods too? ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: S-sure…

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Here's your creamy chocolate latte. I'll set it down right here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! It looks so good! Thank you, King! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the tremendous bombshell force from the news of the Hong Kong meet and greet is so great that King Halo and I remain shaken for the rest of the gathering.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, really?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Everything is about timing and seizing your moment quickly. It's the same in racing, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …H-hey… Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you think so too? Ehe. Two strong sprinters like us really do think alike, huh? ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Could you tell me a little more about what you were talking about earlier? For future reference, of course.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But of course! ♪ Let's talk a bunch until my chocolate latte comes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And just like that, the teacher and student switch roles. I guess seizing the moment really is what's important!
